headline: The Why Atlas reaches about 1,000 people a Short, almost all from the Shorts feed, and keeps them best with challenge hooks and the atlas music.

working.text: Challenge hooks: 59.6% stayed to watch on average (3 Shorts), against 54.9% for question hooks (4 Shorts).
Atlas music: 59.3% stayed (4 Shorts) against 54.9% with explorer (4 Shorts).

notWorking.text: Question hooks: 54.9% stayed (4 Shorts), 4.7 points under challenge hooks, though they drew more views (median 1,219 against 1,060).
Every Short loses most viewers on its second beat; English cities lost 19.1 points at 5.4 s there.

audience.text: 71% of Shorts views in 28 days are from the US, who watch 68% of a Short; India and the Philippines watch about 48–51%.
Mostly men: 25–34 (22.1%) and 35–44 (17.2%) are the largest groups.
81% of views are on phones; 99.9% are from people not subscribed.

recommendations.do: Prefer a challenge hook over a question when the topic allows it.
recommendations.because: Challenge hooks averaged 59.6% stayed to watch against 54.9% for questions (3 and 4 Shorts).

recommendations.do: Make the second beat show part of the answer, not another example.
recommendations.because: The second beat is every Short's steepest fall (19.1 points on English cities).

recommendations.do: End on a question that makes a subscriber, not only a comment.
recommendations.because: 99.9% of views come from non-subscribers, and the channel gained 3 subscribers on 1,114 views of its latest Short.
